Package neqsim.process.equipment.distillation

Class DoeBigHillVacuumFeedMassFlowSensitivity

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.distillation.DoeBigHillVacuumFeedMassFlowSensitivity
public final class DoeBigHillVacuumFeedMassFlowSensitivity extends Object
Immutable feed-mass-flow sensitivity summary for the DOE Big Hill vacuum screening case.

Feed mass flow is varied while all explicit column operating inputs and the feed composition remain fixed. Each point is independently constructed, solved, and evaluated through the qualified Big Hill case and result contracts. The sensitivity is numerical screening evidence, not a measured or calibrated vacuum-column throughput envelope.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public static DoeBigHillVacuumFeedMassFlowSensitivity run(String caseNamePrefix, DoeBigHillVacuumFractionationCase.OperatingInputs baselineInputs, double[] feedMassFlowsKgPerHour)
      Run an independent feed-mass-flow sensitivity at explicit baseline operating inputs.
      Parameters:
      caseNamePrefix - non-blank prefix used for independently constructed point names
      baselineInputs - explicit source-unreported baseline column inputs
      feedMassFlowsKgPerHour - finite positive strictly increasing feed mass flows in kg/h
      Returns:
      immutable sensitivity summary
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if baselineInputs or feedMassFlowsKgPerHour is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name or feed mass flows are invalid
      IllegalStateException - if a point does not solve or pass the qualified result gates
